Under the hood

Why they behave differently

01

Instruction format

OPRDRS1RS2

RISC favors fixed-width fields. Fetch and decode stay predictable, while complex work is composed from several instructions.

02

Memory access

REG→ALU→MEM

A load–store ISA isolates memory access. CISC instructions may combine address calculation, memory access, and arithmetic.

03

Control strategy

Simple instructions map cleanly to hardwired control. Rich instructions may expand into internal micro-operations.

Knowledge check

Design is trade-off,
not a scoreboard.

Modern processors blur the historical line: many CISC cores translate instructions into RISC-like micro-ops, while RISC ISAs continue to add specialized extensions.
